author: SenatorM
quote: Easily the single most disappointing anticipated game of my life. The game was scripted by people who do not understand the base, assigning idiotic tasks that need to be completed in the most mundane and chore-like fashion imaginable, all in an attempt to appease an ungrateful wench **** that is forced upon you. The limited options available to the main character are antithetical to the very core of what has made this game so successful. Whoever put the limitations into this game needs to be fired and never allowed near any video game design ever again. GTA VI is the most disappointing game of the century.
